tower.iam.v1alpha1.ServiceTokenSpec.description: ServiceTokenSpec is the desired state of a service token.

description.description: What the token is for, for people to read.

role.description:
What the token may do. A token never changes role: a client that needs another one gets another token.

- ROLE_ADMIN: Manages tower itself: targets, projects, tokens, secrets.
- ROLE_WORKSTREAM: workstream: states intents in every project and drives the environments in them, including pushing a branch and running commands on a privileged box.
- ROLE_HOSTD: A hostd agent: reads the objects of its own target and reports their status, nothing else.

target.description: The Target a hostd token acts for, by name; required for ROLE_HOSTD and refused for every other role.

tower.iam.v1alpha1.ServiceTokenStatus.description: ServiceTokenStatus is what can be said of a service token's secret without it. The apiserver alone writes it.

conditions.description: None yet: whether the token has a secret, and until when, is secret_prefix and expire_time.

expireTime.description: When the current secret stops working.

issueTime.description: When the current secret was issued.

lastUseTime.description: When the token was last used, to within an hour; unset if never.

secretPrefix.description: The secret's first characters, such as twr_Ab3dE9xQ, to tell which secret someone holds. Empty while it has none.

tower.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

tower.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.tower.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

tower.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

description: ServiceToken is a client's credential: an opaque `twr_` secret it sends as `Authorization: Bearer`, which authenticates it as the principal serviceToken:<name>. What the token may do is its role, fixed when the token is made. Tower keeps only the secret's SHA-256, outside objects: ServiceTokenIssuerService returns the secret once, when it creates or rotates the token, and nothing shows it again. A token made by apply has no secret until it is rotated. Deleting the token revokes its secret at once. See docs/decisions/authentication.md.
title: ServiceToken
